housing.summary: Study Bergen reports that a private apartment in Bergen city centre normally starts at NOK 14,000, that a standard deposit is usually 2–3 months, and that FINN.no is Norway's largest property-listings marketplace. Because the source gives neither the requested average rent nor one exact deposit-month norm, those numeric fields remain null. Evidence: https://www.studybergen.com/guide-to-bergen/just-arrived/accommodation-in-bergen; portal opened: https://www.finn.no/realestate/lettings/search.html

banking.summary: DNB's official onboarding page says applicants with BankID use a Norwegian national identity number and BankID issued by another Norwegian bank; applicants without BankID submit DNB's form and then identify themselves at a DNB office. DNB's identity page lists accepted valid ID, including a Norwegian or foreign passport. Evidence: https://www.dnb.no/en/personal/customer-service/new-customer-outside-norway.html and https://www.dnb.no/en/help-and-guidance/customer-information
required_docs: Norwegian national identity number and BankID issued by another Norwegian bank for online onboarding
Completed DNB customer application form when applying without BankID
Valid proof of identity presented at a DNB office; accepted examples include a Norwegian or foreign passport

schools.summary: Bergen Katedralskole officially offers the two-year International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme in Bergen. Norway's public National School Register provides the schools directory. Evidence: https://www.bergenkatedralskole.vgs.no/utdanningsprogram/vare-utdanningsprogram/international-baccalaureate-diploma-programme-/ and https://data.norge.no/en/datasets/975515ce-e225-3f0c-bda7-27111bb9b024/national-school-register-nsr

legal_admin.summary: UDI states that EU/EEA nationals staying in Norway for more than three months must register under the EU/EEA regulations; non-EU/EEA family members of EU/EEA nationals staying more than three months must apply for a residence card. The police perform EU/EEA registration. Evidence: https://www.udi.no/en/answer-pages/answers-eueea/ and https://www.udi.no/en/word-definitions/registration-certificate-for-eueea-nationals/
legal_admin.registration_step: Follow the UDI route for your nationality: EU/EEA nationals staying more than three months register with the police under the EU/EEA regulations; qualifying non-EU/EEA family members apply for a residence card.

tax_finance.summary: A foreign employee applies for a tax deduction card. Without an electronic ID or an existing Norwegian identity number, the newcomer books a Tax Administration ID check and brings completed form RF-1209; an employer may alternatively apply for the tax card. A D number cannot be self-applied for: an eligible authority or enterprise requests it when needed. Evidence: https://www.skatteetaten.no/en/forms/tax-deduction-card-for-foreign-citizens and https://www.skatteetaten.no/en/person/national-registry/identitetsnummer-og-elektronisk-id/d-nummer/
tax_finance.tax_id_name: Norwegian identification number (national identity number or D number)

transport.summary: Skyss runs buses and Bergen Light Rail; Bergen is in zone A, and the adult one-zone 30-day ticket costs NOK 700 from 1 May 2026. EU/EEA licences can be exchanged for the corresponding Norwegian category without new tests, while non-EU/EEA exchange eligibility is country-specific. Residents registered in the National Population Register have the right to a GP; most D-number holders do not. Evidence: https://skyss.no/en/tickets-and-prices/prices/bus-light-rail-and--some-boat-connections, https://www.skyss.no/en/tickets-and-prices/prize-zones/, https://www.vegvesen.no/en/driving-licences/driving-licence-holders/foreign-driving-licence-in-norway/exchanging-eueea-driving-licences/, https://www.vegvesen.no/en/driving-licences/driving-licence-holders/foreign-driving-licence-in-norway/exchange-of-driving-licences-from-countries-outside-the-eueea/, and https://www.helsenorge.no/en/gp/about-gp/the-right-to-a-doctor/
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences may be exchanged for the corresponding Norwegian category without new tests. For licences issued outside the EU/EEA, exchange is available only for countries specifically listed by the Norwegian Public Roads Administration; otherwise the holder cannot exchange it.
transport.healthcare_registration: Register as a resident in the National Population Register to become entitled to a General Practitioner (fastlege); most people holding only a D number are not entitled to a GP but remain entitled to necessary medical treatment.
